templates.title: Steady thermal slab
templates.description: Evaluate temperature, heat loss and heater temperature through solid material layers with fixed temperature, prescribed outward heat flux or convection ends. Independent conservation checks and optional sampled limits gate publication.
templates.requires: Stable ElmerSolver 26.2 series from 26.2.1 release; serial constant-property solid conduction. All temperatures use kelvin.

snippets.title: Wall conductivity
snippets.description: Change the first solid layer conductivity in W/(m K). Lower conductivity increases thermal resistance.

snippets.title: Right convection film
snippets.description: Set ambient temperature and film coefficient on the right; outward heat loss is h*(T-ambient).
